content: Human-labeling session — econ-mine-and-grow:easy seed 1. Objective: Commander, this is a refinery-placement drill. You hold a Construction Yard (fact), a Power Plant (powr) and one idle harvester (harv, an unarmed ore-collector truck), with $2000 in the bank. An ore patch is visible on the ore-cells channel east of base, centred near (60,20). Within about 40 turns, own an Ore Refinery and reach cash $3000. The harvester auto-mines as soon as a refinery exists.
